project.title: Đội Trưởng Bí Ngô
project.visual_style: photorealistic cinematic live-action children's music video
project.style_anchor: Cinematic 35mm lens look, shallow depth of field, warm clean color grade, soft natural contrast, bright highlights, consistent photographic look throughout.
project.light_direction_anchor: The main key light always comes from screen-left and slightly above, so shadows fall gently toward screen-right. Keep this direction in every clip.
project.palette_anchor: Pumpkin orange, soft lavender purple, warm cream, with glittering gold as the single accent.
project.camera_height_anchor: Camera stays at child eye level, about 1 meter above the ground unless a shot explicitly says otherwise.
project.screen_direction: Story travel direction is left-to-right. Never cross the 180-degree line or mirror the layout.
global_restrictions: Family-friendly Halloween only; no horror, blood, weapons, jump scares or open flame.
No generated text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
Only named reference characters may appear.
important_instructions: Upload an approved boy character reference as @NhatMinh before production.
Each clip is one continuous 8-second shot; add the finished song in editing.

format_lock: Create one continuous 8-second video in 16:9 landscape format. Photorealistic cinematic family-friendly children's music video, natural movement, soft cinematic depth of field, bright clean colors. Use one camera angle or one smooth camera movement only. No abrupt cuts, montage or internal transition. Keep the final two seconds visually stable. Do not generate text, subtitles, captions, dialogue, logo or watermark.
